title: AI Lies Because We Trained It To
hook: AI makes things up. *We trained it to.*

scenes.text: AI chatbots make things up, and we trained them to.

Most tests give points for a right answer and zero for saying I don't know. So, like a student on a multiple choice exam, the model learns that a confident guess scores better than honesty. In 2025, OpenAI researchers argued this is a core reason models hallucinate.
The fix isn't only smarter AI.
It's grading that rewards doubt. Until then, remember...
